name: Mergr
description:
Mergr is a private equity and M&A intelligence platform built to be accessible: straightforward, current data on PE firms, deals, and private companies — no onboarding, no training, no enterprise-database complexity. 

This connector gives Claude direct, read-only access to Mergr's live database: 4,100+ active PE firms, 224,000+ companies, 223,000+ M&A transactions, and 100,000+ original press releases, with ownership histories, deal advisors, and sector analytics.

  Ask questions the way you'd ask an analyst:
  
  • "Which PE firms would be the strongest buyers for a $30M revenue HVAC company in Texas?" — Buyer Match scores financial and strategic buyers against the target's profile.
  
  • "Which sponsors are building roll-ups in collision repair?" — Roll-Up Tracker surfaces active platforms and their add-on velocity.

  • "Which banks and law firms advised the most software deals last year?" — Rankings builds advisor and acquirer league tables with full filtering.

In total, 23 research tools cover firm, company, and deal search with the same filter sets as mergr.com; buyer, investor, and advisor matching; ownership lineage and exit signals; divestiture candidates; investor lookalikes; press-release search; and market analytics. Every answer links back to mergr.com profiles and source press releases, so results are verifiable — not a black box.

Getting started takes seconds: connect with your mergr.com login (read-only — the connector never acts on your behalf). Not a member? Sign up for a free trial at mergr.com.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Mergr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Mergr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.mergr.com/connector. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Mergr MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mergr lists 23 MCP tools, including advisor_match, analytics, buyer_match, company_search, cross_border, deal_search, dossier, entity_profile, firm_portfolio, firm_professionals, firm_search, and investor_lookalikes.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Mergr?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Mergr in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Mergr requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Mergr is developed by Mergr Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
